info.name: POS System
info.description:
Point of Sale System API

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer token. Use the **Login** request to get a token, which is automatically stored in the `token` collection variable via the test script.

## Purchase Immutability Rules
- A purchase is created in **draft** status.
- While **draft**: header can be updated, items can be added/updated/deleted.
- On **complete**: inventory records + stock movements are created, status becomes `completed`.
- Once **completed**: the purchase is **immutable**. No edits, no status changes.
- **Cancel** is only allowed for **draft** purchases.
- All business rule violations return `HTTP 400` with a `DomainException` message.

## Used Device Purchase (Buying from Customers)
Follows the same draft → complete → immutable lifecycle as new device purchases.
- Only `mobile` products are allowed.
- Items include condition tracking (screen, body, battery, fingerprint, Face ID).

## Inventory Rules
- `inventory_items` and `inventory_quantities` are **read-only** APIs.
- `stock_movements` is **read-only**, created automatically by services.

## Sales
- Single-screen POS workflow: search → add to cart → checkout.
- `GET /pos/sales` searches available products (mobiles, accessories, spare parts).
- `POST /pos/checkout` completes the entire sale in one atomic transaction.
- Mobiles are tracked via `inventory_items` (serialized); accessories via `inventory_quantities`.
- `sales_headers` and `sales_items` are read-only after creation.

item.description:
Markup (profit) settings per product type.

**Product types for markup:**
- `new_mobile` - New mobile devices
- `used_mobile` - Used mobile devices
- `accessory` - Accessories
- `spare_part` - Spare parts

**Profit percentage:** 0 to 999.99

item.name: Expense Categories
item.description: Static list of expense categories (enum values)

item.name: Expenses
item.description:
Expense management with status workflow:
1. **Create** → status is `pending`
2. **Pay** → status becomes `paid`
3. **Cancel** → status becomes `cancelled`

**Immutability rules:**
- Only pending expenses can be updated or deleted.
- Pay/cancel only works for pending expenses.

query.description: Filter by category (electricity, water, internet, rent, etc.)

item.name: Update Expense
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only pending expenses can be updated.

item.name: Delete Expense
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only pending expenses can be deleted.

item.name: Pay Expense
item.description: Marks an expense as paid. Only pending expenses can be paid.

item.name: Cancel Expense
item.description: Cancels an expense. Only pending expenses can be cancelled.

item.name: Purchase Headers
item.description:
Purchase order workflow:
1. **Create** → status is `draft`
2. **Add items** via `/purchase-items`
3. **Complete** → creates inventory records + stock movements, status becomes `completed`
4. **Completed purchases are immutable** — no edits, no cancellation
5. **Cancel** only works for **draft** purchases

**Error responses for business rule violations (HTTP 400):**
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "Only draft purchases can be completed.",
    "errors": null
}
```

query.description: Search by purchase number or supplier invoice number

item.name: Update Purchase Header
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only draft purchases can be updated.
- The `status` field is **not allowed** in the request body.
- Status can only be changed via `Complete` or `Cancel` endpoints.

**Validation:** `supplier_id` is optional on update (`sometimes`).

**Error response if completed/cancelled:**
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "لا يمكن تعديل فاتورة مكتملة أو ملغاة.",
    "errors": null
}
```

item.name: Delete Purchase Header
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only draft purchases can be deleted.

item.name: Complete Purchase Header
item.description:
**Business flow:**
1. Validates purchase is in `draft` status
2. Creates `inventory_items` for mobile products (one per device)
3. Increments `inventory_quantities` for accessories/spare_parts
4. Creates `stock_movements` for all items
5. Sets status to `completed` and records `completed_at` timestamp

**After completion:** Purchase becomes immutable.

**Error if already completed or cancelled:**
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "Only draft purchases can be completed.",
    "errors": null
}
```

**Error if no items:**
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "Cannot complete purchase without items.",
    "errors": null
}
```

item.name: Cancel Purchase Header
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only draft purchases can be cancelled.

If the purchase is already completed or cancelled:
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "Only draft purchases can be cancelled.",
    "errors": null
}
```

item.name: Purchase Items
item.description:
**Purchase items are top-level resources (not nested under purchase headers).**

**Immutability rules:**
- Items can only be added/updated/deleted while the purchase is **draft**.
- If the purchase is `completed` or `cancelled`, all mutation requests return `HTTP 400`.

**Error response for any mutation on a non-draft purchase:**
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "Cannot modify a completed purchase.",
    "errors": null
}
```

**Typical workflow:**
1. Create a purchase header (draft)
2. Add items via `POST /purchase-items` (include `purchase_header_id` in body)
3. Complete the purchase
4. The items become read-only

**Note:** Responses include the related `product` object eager-loaded on all read endpoints.

item.name: List Purchase Items
item.description:
Lists all purchase items. Filter by purchase header using `purchase_header_id` query param.

Response includes the related `product` object (eager-loaded).

item.name: Create Purchase Item
item.description:
Adds an item to a draft purchase.

**Quantity rules:**
- For `mobile` products: quantity must be a whole number (each device gets one `inventory_items` record on complete)
- For `accessory` / `spare_part`: quantity can be fractional

**Note:** `purchase_header_id` is required in the request body (flat API, not nested).

item.name: Get Purchase Item
item.description: Returns a single purchase item with the related `product` object eager-loaded.

item.name: Update Purchase Item
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only items in a draft purchase can be updated.

**Note:** `purchase_header_id` is not accepted in the request body — items cannot be moved between purchase headers via update.

**Validation:** `product_id`, `quantity`, and `unit_cost` are all required.

item.name: Delete Purchase Item
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only items in a draft purchase can be deleted.

Note: deleting an item recalculates the purchase header's `total_amount`.

item.name: Purchase Returnable
item.description:
Read-only endpoints for purchases eligible for return.

Only **completed** purchases with items that have remaining returnable quantity are shown.
- Each item's returnable quantity = `quantity_purchased - already_returned_qty`
- For mobiles: individual `inventory_items` that are still `available` can be returned
- For accessories/spare_parts: limited by remaining stock

query.description: Search by purchase number or supplier name

item.name: Get Purchase Returnable
item.description:
Returns detailed returnable items for a specific purchase.
- Includes per-item returnable quantity and pricing

item.name: Purchase Returns
item.description:
Purchase return management.

**Workflow:**
1. Look up returnable purchases via `/purchase-returnable`
2. Submit a return via `POST /purchase-returns`
3. View returns via `GET /purchase-returns` and `GET /purchase-returns/{id}`

**Item rules:**
- Each return item must reference a `purchase_item_id`
- For mobiles: `inventory_item_id` identifies the specific device
- For accessories/spare_parts: only `quantity` is needed
- Returns are processed atomically — stock is adjusted automatically

query.description: Search by return number, purchase number, or supplier name

item.name: Create Purchase Return
item.description:
Processes a purchase return atomically.

**Request validation:**
- `purchase_header_id` is required
- `items` array must have at least 1 item
- Each item needs `purchase_item_id`, `quantity`, `unit_refund_amount`
- For mobiles: include `inventory_item_id`

item.name: Get Purchase Return
item.description: Returns a single purchase return with items, product details, and inventory item info.

item.name: Used Device Purchase Headers
item.description:
Purchase of used mobile devices from customers.

**Workflow (same as new device purchases):**
1. Create → status is `draft`
2. Add items via `/used-purchase-headers/{purchase}/items`
3. Complete → creates inventory records + stock movements, status becomes `completed`
4. Completed purchases are immutable
5. Cancel only works for draft purchases

**Error responses for business rule violations (HTTP 400):**
```json
{
    "success": false,
    "status": 400,
    "message": "Only draft purchases can be completed.",
    "errors": null
}
```

item.name: Update Used Purchase Header
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only draft purchases can be updated.
- The `status` field is **not allowed** in the request body.
- Status can only be changed via `Complete` or `Cancel` endpoints.

**Note:** `purchase_number` has unique validation (ignores current record).

item.name: Delete Used Purchase Header
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only draft purchases can be deleted.

item.name: Complete Used Purchase Header
item.description:
**Business flow:**
1. Validates purchase is in `draft` status
2. Creates `inventory_items` records for each mobile device (one per unit of quantity)
3. Creates `stock_movements` for all items
4. Sets status to `completed` and records `completed_at` timestamp

**After completion:** Purchase becomes immutable.

item.name: Cancel Used Purchase Header
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only draft purchases can be cancelled.

item.name: Used Device Purchase Items
item.description:
Purchase items are nested under used device purchase headers.

**Immutability rules:**
- Items can only be added/updated/deleted while the purchase is **draft**.
- If the purchase is `completed` or `cancelled`, all mutation requests return `HTTP 400`.

**Item validation:**
- Only `mobile` products are allowed.
- Includes device condition fields: battery_health, screen_condition, body_condition, fingerprint_working, face_id_working.

**Typical workflow:**
1. Create a purchase header (draft)
2. Add items via `POST /used-purchase-headers/{purchase}/items`
3. Complete the purchase
4. The items become read-only

item.name: Create Used Purchase Item
item.description:
Adds a used mobile device item to a draft purchase.

**Condition fields:**
- `battery_health`: integer 0-100 (battery health percentage)
- `screen_condition`: e.g., "Good", "Scratched", "Cracked"
- `body_condition`: e.g., "Excellent", "Worn", "Damaged"
- `fingerprint_working`: boolean
- `face_id_working`: boolean

item.name: Update Used Purchase Item
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only items in a draft purchase can be updated.

All fields use `sometimes` validation (partial updates allowed).

item.name: Delete Used Purchase Item
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only items in a draft purchase can be deleted.

item.name: Inventory (Read Only)
item.description:
Inventory tables are **read-only** APIs.
No direct insert/update/delete from controllers.
Inventory changes happen automatically through business services:
- Purchase Complete
- Sale
- Purchase Return
- Sales Return
- etc.

item.name: List Inventory Quantities
item.description:
Returns current stock quantities for quantity-based products (accessories & spare parts).
- One row per product
- Updated automatically on purchase/sale/return

item.name: List Inventory Items
item.description:
Returns individual device records for serialized products (mobiles).
- One row per physical device
- Each device has a unique `internal_serial`
- Status can be: `available`, `sold`, `returned`, `under_repair`, `damaged`

item.name: List Stock Movements
item.description:
Returns all inventory transactions.
Movement types: `purchase`, `sale`, `sales_return`, `purchase_return`, `repair_usage`, `damaged`, `lost`, `stock_adjustment`, `opening_stock`

This is an **audit log** — automatically created by business services. No direct writes.

item.name: Sales
item.description:
Point-of-Sale operations.

**Single-screen POS workflow:**
1. Search products via `GET /pos/sales?query=`
2. Frontend adds items to cart
3. Send `POST /pos/checkout` to complete

**Validation rules (Checkout):**
- Items must contain either `product_id` (accessory/spare part) or `inventory_item_id` (mobile).
- `quantity` is **required** for accessories/spare parts, **optional** for mobiles (defaults to 1).
- `unit_price` is required for all items.
- Business rule violations (e.g., insufficient stock) return `HTTP 422`.

**Immutability:** Sales headers and items are read-only after creation.

query.description: Filter by type: all, new_mobile, used_mobile, accessory, spare_part

item.name: POS Checkout
item.description:
Completes the entire sale inside one atomic `DB::transaction`.

**Item types:**
- **Mobile** (`inventory_item_id`): Sets status to `sold`, creates StockMovement with qty=1.
- **Accessory / Spare Part** (`product_id` + `quantity`): Atomically decrements `inventory_quantities` with stock guard. Throws 422 if insufficient stock.

**Atomic operations:**
1. Validate all items (stock, product type)
2. Calculate subtotal, apply discount
3. Create Sales Header
4. Create Sales Items
5. Update inventory (status=sold / quantity decrement)
6. Create Stock Movements
7. Return completed invoice

item.description: Returns paginated sales headers with customer info.

item.name: Sales Returnable

Read-only endpoints for sales eligible for return.

Only sales with items that have remaining returnable quantity are shown.
- Each item's returnable quantity = `quantity_sold - already_returned_qty`

query.description: Search by invoice number or customer name

item.name: Get Sales Returnable
item.description:
Returns detailed returnable items for a specific sale.
- Includes per-item returnable quantity and pricing

item.name: Sales Returns
item.description:
Sales return management.

**Workflow:**
1. Look up returnable sales via `/sales-returnable`
2. Submit a return via `POST /sales-returns`
3. View returns via `GET /sales-returns` and `GET /sales-returns/{id}`

**Item rules:**
- Each return item must reference a `sales_item_id` and `product_id`
- For mobiles: `inventory_item_id` identifies the specific device being returned
- Returns are processed atomically — stock is adjusted automatically

query.description: Search by return number, invoice number, or customer name

item.name: Create Sales Return
item.description:
Processes a sales return atomically.

**Request validation:**
- `sales_header_id` is required
- `items` array must have at least 1 item
- Each item needs `sales_item_id`, `product_id`, `quantity`, `unit_refund_amount`, `total_refund`
- For mobiles: include `inventory_item_id`

item.name: Get Sales Return
item.description: Returns a single sales return with items, product details, and inventory item info.

item.name: Maintenance
item.description:
Maintenance management system.

**Workflow:**
1. Create a **Maintenance Ticket** (`POST /maintenance-tickets`) — atomically creates device + header.
2. Or manage **devices** and **headers** separately.
3. Add **operations** (repair actions) and **used parts** (spare parts) to headers.
4. Update status via `POST /maintenance-headers/{id}/status`.

**Maintenance statuses:** pending, under_repair, waiting_parts, repaired, delivered, cancelled

item.name: Create Maintenance Ticket
item.description:
Atomically creates a maintenance device (or uses existing) and a maintenance header in one request.

If `maintenance_device_id` is provided, uses existing device.
Otherwise, creates a new device with: `device_type`, `brand`, `model`, `serial_number`, `color`, `condition_notes`.

**Validation:**
- `device_type` is required when `maintenance_device_id` is not provided
- `problem_description` is required
- `received_date` is required

body.raw:
{
  "device_type": "Smartphone",
  "brand": "Samsung",
  "model": "Galaxy S24",
  "serial_number": "SN123456789",
  "color": "Black",
  "condition_notes": "Scratches on screen, body in good condition",
  "problem_description": "Phone not charging, battery drains quickly",
  "received_date": "2024-12-01",
  "delivery_date": "2024-12-10",
  "advance_payment": 200.00,
  "notes": "Customer requested express service"
}

query.description: Search by serial number or product name
Search by ticket number, customer name, or serial number
Filter by status (pending, under_repair, waiting_parts, repaired, delivered, cancelled)

item.name: Update Maintenance Header
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Cannot update headers that are `delivered` or `cancelled`.

item.name: Delete Maintenance Header
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only `pending` headers can be deleted.

item.name: Update Maintenance Status
item.description:
Updates the status of a maintenance header.

**Allowed statuses:** pending, under_repair, waiting_parts, repaired, delivered, cancelled

When changing to `delivered`, `delivery_date` and `paid_amount` can be provided.

item.name: Maintenance Operations
item.description:
Operations are nested under maintenance headers.
- Each operation represents a repair action performed.
- Operations can only be added/updated while the header is not delivered/cancelled.

item.name: Maintenance Used Parts
item.description:
Used parts are nested under maintenance headers.
- Only `spare_part` products are allowed.
- Parts can only be added/updated while the header is not delivered/cancelled.

item.name: Create Maintenance Used Part
item.description:
Adds a spare part used in maintenance.

**Validation:**
- Only `spare_part` type products are allowed
- `quantity` must be > 0
- Uses product's current cost price automatically

item.name: Salary
item.description:
Salary management system.

**Salary Assignment:**
- Each user can have one active salary assignment
- `base_salary` defines the base salary amount

**Salary Payment:**
- Payments are created in `draft` status
- Items (earnings/deductions) are added via `/salary-payments/{payment}/items`
- Use `confirm` to finalize the payment
- `cancel` only works for draft payments

**Salary Payment Item Types:**
- `base_salary` - Base salary
- `overtime` - Overtime pay
- `bonus` - Bonus
- `commission` - Commission
- `deduction` - Deduction (subtracted)
- `advance_repayment` - Advance repayment (subtracted)
- `adjustment` - Adjustment

item.name: Create Salary Assignment
item.description:
Assigns a base salary to a user.

**Validation:**
- `user_id` is required and must be unique (a user can only have one assignment)
- `base_salary` must be >= 0

item.name: Delete Salary Assignment
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Cannot delete if there are payments linked to this assignment.

item.name: Create Salary Payment
item.description:
Creates a draft salary payment for a user.

**Workflow:**
1. Create payment (draft)
2. Add items via `/salary-payments/{payment}/items`
3. Confirm the payment
The `notes` field is optional.

item.name: Update Salary Payment
item.description: **Immutability rule:** Only draft payments can be updated.

item.name: Delete (Cancel) Salary Payment
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only draft payments can be cancelled.

Sets status to `cancelled`.

item.name: Confirm Salary Payment
item.description: Confirms a draft salary payment, marking it as finalized.

item.name: Cancel Salary Payment
item.description: Cancels a draft salary payment via the service layer.

item.name: Salary Payment Items
item.description:
Items are nested under salary payments.

**Item types:** `base_salary`, `overtime`, `bonus`, `commission`, `deduction`, `advance_repayment`, `adjustment`

**Immutability rules:**
- Items can only be added/updated/deleted while the payment is **draft**.
- `base_salary` type items cannot have their type changed.

item.name: Create Salary Payment Item
item.description:
Adds an item to a draft salary payment.

**Item types:**
- `base_salary` / `overtime` / `bonus` / `commission` — additions
- `deduction` / `advance_repayment` — subtractions
- `adjustment` — can be positive or negative

item.name: Update Salary Payment Item
item.description:
**Immutability rule:**
- Only items in draft payments can be updated.
- `base_salary` type items cannot change their type.

item.name: Delete Salary Payment Item
item.description:
**Immutability rule:** Only items in draft payments can be deleted.

Recalculates the payment total after deletion.
